steps.title: Open Trendora's home page
steps.narration: Let's start where every visit begins — the home page, showing today's market regime at a glance.
steps.point_out: The regime card and score appear right away, with no error banner or blank space.

steps.title: Check the Data Manager's status
steps.narration: Next, the Data Manager, where new market data arrives. A status badge near the top of every page always reflects the backend's real, current health.
steps.point_out: The badge reads "Ready" in green — an honest, live signal, not a guess.

steps.title: See the latest completed data run
steps.narration: The Job progress panel keeps a summary of the most recent data run, even if you weren't the one who started it.
steps.point_out: The summary lists everything that was refreshed, including the forward-looking figures used on the Backtest page — computed once when the data arrived, never recalculated on the spot.

steps.title: Confirm it in Run history too
steps.narration: Scrolling down, the Run history table keeps a permanent record of every data run that has ever completed, even after a reload.
steps.point_out: That same run still shows a clean status here, with the same forward-looking figures confirmed a second, independent way.

steps.title: Try a wide historical date range
steps.narration: Back at the top of the Data Manager, the backfill form still accepts any historical range you like, with no hidden size limit.

steps.title: No range cap enforced
steps.narration: Even a span of more than a decade is accepted without any warning or truncation.
steps.point_out: Notice there's no error message or size warning — just a normal, ready-to-submit form.

steps.title: Open the Backtest page's evidence panel
steps.narration: The evidence panel at the bottom of the Backtest page now always tells you plainly whether it's showing the fully current numbers, a clearly labeled last-good version while newer data finishes processing, or an honest not-yet-computed notice — instead of silently going quiet or making you wait with no explanation.
steps.point_out: The evidence tables are fully populated with real figures and there's no refreshing notice showing — this is the everyday, fully current view, now backed by an explicit on-screen guarantee.

steps.title: Spot-check Scanner Runs
steps.narration: One last stop — the Scanner Runs history, which lists every dated scan that has ever been saved.
steps.point_out: Past runs are still listed here with their full detail one click away, confirming this round's behind-the-scenes changes didn't disturb anything else.
